components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background-color: #569BAA; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; border: 1px solid #569BAA; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #457A87; border-color: #457A87; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(86, 155, 170, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); scale: 0.98; }

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.description: Secondary or inverted CTA on dark hero overlays.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background-color: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Floating Card
components.description: White container with generous 24px radius resting on subtle slate backgrounds.
components.html:
Zero CapEx Deployment

Integrate with existing boom barriers and cameras in under 48 hours without costly hardware replacements.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #0F172A; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #64748B; margin: 0; }

components.name: Pill Badge
components.description: Subtle indicator badge for system status and platform modules.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background-color: rgba(86, 155, 170, 0.1); color: #569BAA; border: 1px solid rgba(86, 155, 170, 0.25); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Light, accessible form input with smooth focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background-color: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 18px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #0F172A; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { background-color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #569BAA; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(86, 155, 170, 0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; }

narrative.overview: The Irken Solutions visual system embodies digital transformation within the Mobility and smart parking sector. The design merges clean, approachable whitespace with high-trust precision (inspired by modern consumer fintech platforms like Paymob). It emphasizes extreme legibility, generous organic curves, tactile pill buttons, and soft floating depth.
keyCharacteristics: Bright & Approachable Canvas with white (#FFFFFF) and slate-50 (#F8FAFC) foundations.
Generous Radii (24px to 32px) and strict pill-shaped (rounded-full) buttons.
Offset geometric color layering creating structured visual depth.
High-contrast dark overlays (#0A1118) for cinematic hero video and grounded footers.
Bilingual typographic harmony across English (Space Grotesk/Inter) and Arabic (Tajawal).

rules.name: The Light Canvas Rule
rules.body: Primary marketing sections default to clean white (#FFFFFF) or Slate 50 (#F8FAFC). Avoid dense dark backgrounds on general marketing content.

rules.name: The Offset Layering Rule
rules.body: White feature cards rest on offset colored blocks (cyan, purple, blue) to create depth and visual structure without heavy drop shadows.

rules.name: The Generous Curve Rule
rules.body: All structural cards and containers must use 24px (rounded-3xl) or 32px (rounded-[2rem]) corner radii. Sharp corners (0px–8px) are prohibited on cards.

rules.name: The Strict Pill Rule
rules.body: All interactive buttons, status tags, and sector badges must use full pill geometry (rounded-full / 9999px).

rules.name: The Bilingual Symmetry Rule
rules.body: Arabic typography (Tajawal) is rendered with identical visual weight and baseline alignment as English headlines, with layout mirroring automatically handled in RTL.

dos: Do use rounded-full for all buttons, badges, and status pills.
Do use 24px+ radii (rounded-3xl, rounded-[2rem]) for cards and containers.
Do maintain generous vertical whitespace (py-20 to py-28) across marketing sections.
Do preserve authentic PropTech and smart mobility domain language (Zero CapEx, LPR Flow, Yield Intelligence).
Do use inline SVG or uniform Lucide icons with 1.75–2px stroke weights.
donts: Don't use rectangular or squarish (4px–8px) buttons.
Don't use dense, text-heavy developer UI blocks on public marketing surfaces.
Don't hardcode ad-hoc hex colors in components; use semantic theme tokens and CSS variables.
Don't create dead anchor links; always route to active anchors (#solutions, #integration) or live routes.
